adaptation.scope: Source listboxes use complete public control.SelectRoot current-window slots. Configuration/language selectors alone follow Gallery Flyout/Native. No cross-window scope/Element capture.
adaptation.desktopGap: The current public desktop.Select single-string facade does not implement complete item-aligned/multiple source slots. This stage retains full source behavior in the existing current-window control, not an independent Flyout/OS claim. Rich independent Select is a separate SDK adaptation gate.
adaptation.nativeInline: The source Inline NativeSelect is always the real OS single-select menu. OS rendering/placement are native. Separate native-select-example.tsx is not counted as a Select recipe.
adaptation.sourceNull: A reserved private string identity maps source nullable rendered items to invalid selection. Grouped/scrollable source placeholders are not rendered items and remain trigger placeholders only.
adaptation.sourceObjects: Plan objects stay in application-owned static descriptors and use name identities with exact rich item/value visuals.
adaptation.width: Explicit192/256/320/128/112/140/288DIP widths are retained. Unspecified CSS natural widths use a384DIP native available-card cap; sides/inline use560DIP available cap. Narrow inline fixed controls retain an accessible horizontal viewport with32DIP minimum editable space.
adaptation.localActions: Source Submit buttons have no transport handler. Native clicks only record a local snapshot/count; no added Enter/form/network submission.
adaptation.icons: Existing on-demand Material Symbols SVG equivalents replace source icon-family placeholders; no icon font or new asset.
adaptation.state: Only strings/counters/maps/public SelectState persist. Context/Element/SelectScope/FieldScope/callbacks remain current-build only.
adaptation.verification: One concentrated public native-input flow and4 software PNGs. No OS popup/tracking, real IME/AT, multi-display or full platform/font/visual acceptance claim.
adaptation.itemAlignedRepair: Source timezone native flow first exposed negative fitted top and last-row pointer blocked by overlaid arrow. Public fitted attachment geometry and one-shot arrow-aware reveal fix exact panel/window bounds without a fake MaxHeight; the existing SDK long-list flow covers End/Home pointer/focus and free wheel scrolling.
